title: Pap, wors and chakalaka
summary: Braai night, sized to your goals.
steps: For stiff pap, bring salted water to the boil, about twice the volume of the maize meal. Stir the maize meal in bit by bit with a wooden spoon so no lumps form. Cover and steam on low for 20 minutes, stirring firmly every 5 minutes.
Braai the wors, or fry it in a dry pan over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning often, until browned and cooked through with no pink inside.
For the chakalaka, grate the carrot and chop the onion, pepper and tomato. Fry the onion, carrot and pepper in the oil with a pinch of curry powder for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and baked beans, simmer for 5 minutes and season.
Serve the pap with the wors and the chakalaka.
